audit.whatIsWrong: Early text calls Levels 1-3 hers but never says why the lane stabilises, and the difficulty framing ignores that Hallowed Mist (W, 22/21/20/19/18s) is the single gate on every commit.
audit.why: Gwen's Snip Snip! (Q, 6.5s falling to 3.5s at rank 5) deals true damage in the centre cone, so Granite Shield and armour both read the early trade wrong. Malphite has no answer until Thunderclap and Ground Slam are both up.
audit.corrected: Early belongs to Gwen on true-damage poke; Levels 4-5 are genuinely even once Thunderclap (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) and Ground Slam (7s) are online; side lane and 2+ items swing back to her.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike is described as a kill threat without naming what makes it one, and the 2+ item spike credited Gwen with a resistance 'shred' she does not have.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s and 100 mana — a spike you get roughly once per wave state, not a trade tool. Needlework (R, 120/100/80s) slows and applies A Thousand Cuts; it does not reduce resistances.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike = R as the one tool that reaches her through mist. 2+ item spike = her true damage plus near-permanent mist uptime, not shred.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page states Hallowed Mist makes her 'untargetable to your R, E and Q' — it lumps Unstoppable Force in with the targeted abilities.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist protects her from enemies OUTSIDE it (Riot: 'She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist'). Seismic Shard is a targeted 625-range ability and is denied from outside. Unstoppable Force is a 1000-range dash to a LOCATION — it puts Malphite inside the mist, where the protection no longer applies. Ground Slam then lands because he is stood in it with her.
audit.corrected: Q is denied from outside the mist; R is a point dash that lands you inside it, which is why R-into-mist is the commit and Q-from-outside is wasted mana.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere — no 'wait for X before you Y' line.
audit.why: Skip 'n Slash (E) is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s but is PARTIALLY REFUNDED if she hits something during the buff, so it is only a real window when she whiffs it. Hallowed Mist is the honest 18-22s window.
audit.corrected: Commit on the mist cooldown, not on her E — her E refunds itself on hit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommends Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart / Thornmail 'by his AD profile' against a champion whose damage is magic and true, directly contradicting the page's own TL;DR of 'build MR'.
audit.why: Gwen's Snip Snip! is magic plus true damage and A Thousand Cuts is magic on-hit. Armour and armour-based items do nothing here, and Ground Slam scales off armour so the choice is not free.
audit.corrected: MR line instead, with Grievous Wounds called out for A Thousand Cuts healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Need Color' is used twice as a Gwen ability and credited with resistance shred.
audit.why: Gwen's R is Needlework. It is a projectile that slows and applies A Thousand Cuts, castable up to three times. There is no shred in her kit.
audit.corrected: Name killed in spikes[3].text, wants.foe[1] and late.

edits.before: Gwen's biggest window: full mist uptime plus Q true damage and Need Color shred out-scale your armor stack one-on-one.
edits.after: Gwen's biggest window: near-permanent Hallowed Mist plus Snip Snip! true damage out-scale the armor stack that is your whole 1v1.

edits.before: Stack her Q true damage and Need Color shred to melt your Granite Shield and armor
edits.after: Stack Snip Snip! true damage, which ignores Granite Shield and every point of armor

edits.before: Her Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable to your R, E and Q, so unless you bait the mist your Level 6 spike whiffs and she keeps the edge.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist blanks your 625-range Q from outside, but R is a dash to a location — it lands you inside the mist, where she is fair game.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you finally farm safely as Thunderclap armor and Ground Slam come online, and the slow on Seismic Shard lets you contest. Level 6 is your one real window: Unstoppable Force is the only tool that beats her Hallowed Mist, but only if you time it for when her mist is down or her E dash is on cooldown — knock her up before she pops mist and becomes untargetable to your R, E and Q all at once. Bait the mist, then commit.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you finally farm safely as Thunderclap armor and Ground Slam come online, and the slow on Seismic Shard lets you contest. Level 6 is your one real window: Unstoppable Force is the only tool that reaches her through Hallowed Mist, because it dashes you to a location — you land inside the mist and Ground Slam lands with you. Don't Q from outside it; that is mana into nothing. Her mist is 18-22s, so that is the clock you commit on.

edits.before: This is Gwen's game. Her Q is true damage and her Need Color shred ignores the armor that is your entire identity, so the durable frontline you build does not hold up in a straight 1v1. Don't try to solo her once she has two items — sit in mist and she dodges everything you have. Your value is no longer the duel; it's R flanking onto her carries in a 5v5 and letting your team punish her while she's locked into the fight. Play for the teamfight engage, not the sidelane.
edits.after: This is Gwen's game. Snip Snip! is true damage in the centre cone and A Thousand Cuts heals her off every auto, so the armor that is your entire identity buys you nothing in a straight 1v1. Don't try to solo her once she has two items — poke her from outside the mist and you deal literally zero. Your value is no longer the duel; it's R flanking onto her carries in a 5v5, and Grievous Wounds before anyone commits to an extended fight with her. Play for the teamfight engage, not the sidelane.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force is a teamfight win button — the lane is just where you bank it. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gwen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is your only reach into Hallowed Mist — it dashes to a location, so you land inside it. 130s at rank 1: spend it on her mist, never on chip.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside. Fight when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gwen Hallowed Mist (22/21/20/19/18s): matchup-defining — outside it you cannot touch her. Commit on it, not her E: Skip 'n Slash refunds part of its 13s on hit. - Unstoppable Force 130/115/100s: kill windows only.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Poke from outside it and you deal nothing — R in or wait out its 18s.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart  (by his AD profile), then Thornmail / Abyssal Mask; boots Mercury's Treads. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Her damage is magic and true, so armor is the wrong buy: Sunfire Aegis into Abyssal Mask, Kaenic Rookern into heavy chip; boots Mercury's Treads. A Thousand Cuts heals off her autos — bring Grievous Wounds.

notes: Gwen R was written as 'Need Color' twice and credited with resistance shred; her R is Needlework and shreds nothing. Kit-file flag check: Malphite's Q and E both carry a 'grounding' derived flag and R carries 'projectile' — all three contradict Riot's own descriptions (Q steals move speed, E slows attack speed, R is a location dash) and I did not assert any of them. The R-into-Hallowed-Mist claim is rated Medium: it follows from Riot's wording that the mist protects her from enemies OUTSIDE it plus R being a location dash, but the kit file's needsResearch block is empty so I could not confirm the exact damage-application order on arrival.
